digest.component_or_area: LLM provider construction and lifecycle management
propositions: Provider construction logic is currently inlined in runner.py:268 with provider-specific branches scattered across run(), preventing unified provider registration and making each new provider require runner.py surgery

httpx.AsyncClient lifecycle management must survive across the infer_model hook boundary, which only returns a Provider; ProviderSession must own _closeables list and expose provider_factory callable matching pydantic-ai's (str) -> Provider signature

Anthropic provider builder must be relocated to providers.py while preserving existing behavior: tenacity transport, max_retries=0 guard, loopback-proxy bypass, and per-request httpx.Timeout remain unchanged

run() must wrap its body in ProviderSession context manager, replacing the :446-452 finally-block teardown with session.__exit__, and replacing the :268 inline branch with session.provider_factory passed to infer_model
All httpx.AsyncClient instances created during run() must be verified closed after both normal return and exception paths, asserted on real client object closed state, not call counts
